ops.title: Post the first full day's lost-pass count on cc-skills#3421
ops.description: Count Nov 6 (Pacific) finder and fidelity passes on the Mac that ended with no_result, and how many of their job.log files end in 'cannot resume output at byte 0', using python3 ~/.vcache/scratch/grade-green-heads/lost-since.py <epoch of 2026-11-06T00:00-08:00> ~/.local/state/lr-scratch/durable-agents-rebuild (the scratch root ~/.claude/scratch/durable-agents-rebuild is a symlink to it, so count it once). Add the result to the After paragraph of yasyf/cc-skills#3421. Interim, 5:30 to 6:30 PM Nov 5: 187 passes, 2 lost, 0 to the stream error.

ops.text: cc-skills#3421's body gives Nov 6's full-day lost-pass count beside Nov 5's 117 of 132
